meta.title: Risk register - every decision, business-as-usual and black swan
meta.likelihood_scale: High = more likely than not within the remaining lease term. Medium = plausible, roughly 1-in-4 to 1-in-2. Low = plausible but under 1-in-4. Rare = tail, under 1-in-20, or no reliable base rate.
meta.impact_scale: High = a change of 10% or more in the Owner's after-tax outcome, or loss of the ability to choose. Medium = 3-10%. Low = under 3%.

strategy_codes.HOLD: Passive hold to lease expiry, then react
strategy_codes.WAIT2Y: Wait two years, then sell with less term remaining
strategy_codes.EXT_SELL: Extend in 2027, sell in 2030 with long remaining term
strategy_codes.SELL_1031: Sell in 2026 through a Section 1031 exchange

rows.event: Tenant declines to renew at expiry and the building goes dark
rows.mitigation: Never let the remaining term fall below about five years before deciding. Open the renewal conversation in 2026-2027, not 2029.
rows.basis: Assumption A06; the tenant's lease-renewal practice was not re-verified this session (flagged U-16).

rows.event: Renewal is granted only on rent concessions or a shorter term than the Owner wants
rows.mitigation: Set a written walk-away: no extension below ten years and no reduction in in-place rent without a corresponding sale decision.
rows.basis: Analyst judgement; the lease terms are unknown (U-04, U-05).

rows.event: Rent is materially below market, so the asset is worth more vacant-and-re-let than occupied
rows.mitigation: Obtain a broker opinion of market rent before agreeing any extension. If in-place rent is more than 10% below market, prefer sale.

rows.event: Tenant credit deteriorates: negative stockholders' equity of -$901.3 million at 2026-07-05 and a history of annual losses
rows.mitigation: Test whether the lease is with the corporate parent or a franchisee. Require corporate guaranty or a larger security deposit at renewal.

rows.event: Brand-level store closures reduce the likelihood of renewal at this specific site
rows.mitigation: Track the tenant's unit count in each 10-Q; a shrinking system is a leading indicator for non-renewal.
rows.basis: Analyst judgement; unit-level closure guidance from the FY2025 10-K was not re-verified this session (flagged U-16).

rows.event: Franchisee cost squeeze: California fast-food wage of $20.00/hour plus local wage inflation of +3.9%
rows.mitigation: Ask for the store's four-wall coverage ratio and the last four quarters of sales before renewal. A thin-margin franchisee is the real renewal risk.

rows.event: Capitalisation rates widen because the 10-year Treasury stays near 4.9%-5.1%
rows.mitigation: Sell into strength rather than into a rate spike. Cap rates are the largest single driver of value in the model.

rows.event: Term decay: each year that passes removes a year of contracted rent and widens the cap rate
rows.mitigation: This is the risk that a do-nothing strategy silently takes. It is quantified in the projection model.

rows.event: Population decline in the trade area
rows.mitigation: Population loss of 3.2% county-wide since 2020 is a slow headwind on volume, not a cliff. Weight it in the exit multiple, not in a single year's forecast.

rows.event: Entertainment and information employment contraction removes daytime foot traffic
rows.mitigation: Information has lost 10,200 county jobs in a year and has fallen in 20 of the last 22 months. A Central Los Angeles site tied to studio-adjacent lunch traffic is more exposed than the county average.

rows.event: Job growth stalls: county payrolls up only 0.4% year over year, all of it in education and health
rows.mitigation: Restaurant employment is still growing (+7,300 county-wide), which is the more relevant series.

rows.event: Consumer pullback hits quick-service volume
rows.mitigation: City poverty of 16.5% makes the value end of the market relatively resilient, but a value chain with a $20 wage floor has limited room to cut price.

rows.event: Buyer financing costs limit the pool of purchasers for a sub-$10 million single-tenant asset
rows.mitigation: All-cash and 1031 buyers are the natural bid for this size; that is also why timing matters more than a few basis points of price.

rows.event: Measure ULA adds 4.0% to the City transfer tax once the price reaches $5,400,000, and 5.5% at $10,900,000
rows.likelihood: High if the asset is large enough
rows.mitigation: Compute the cliff before listing: at a 5.65% cap the threshold sits at roughly $305,000 of annual NOI. A 1031 exchange does not avoid the tax; it only defers the gain.

rows.event: A sale resets the Proposition 13 base, so the tenant's tax reimbursement jumps in year one
rows.mitigation: Show the buyer and the tenant the post-sale tax number. A large reassessment can turn a renewal into a renegotiation.

rows.event: Taxable sale: combined federal and state tax takes roughly a third or more of the gain
rows.likelihood: High if sold without an exchange
rows.mitigation: Structure the sale through a qualified intermediary if the intent is to stay invested.
rows.basis: Assumptions A10 and A11 built on S14 and S13.

rows.event: Section 1031 repeal or restriction enacted before closing
rows.mitigation: Do not make the exchange the only plan. Have a taxable fallback priced and ready, and do not delay a decision solely to preserve deferral.
rows.basis: Legislative proposals have repeatedly targeted Section 1031; no enacted change is assumed. Analyst judgement.

rows.event: The 1031 exchange fails: no replacement identified in 45 days or no closing in 180 days
rows.mitigation: Identify replacement property before closing, use a qualified intermediary, and keep an identified back-up in the same state to preserve deferral.

rows.event: Major earthquake causes structural damage or a total loss
rows.likelihood: Rare in any single year, but the region's 30-year exposure is high
rows.mitigation: Obtain a seismic (probable maximum loss) report before renewal; verify earthquake cover and deductibles. The 30-year probability figure is left blank rather than quoted from a secondary source (U-10).

rows.event: Wildfire-driven urban conflagration or smoke and power-shutoff disruption
rows.likelihood: Rare for a dense central site, but the January 2025 fire pair shows the regional tail is real
rows.mitigation: Get the parcel's Fire Hazard Severity Zone before renewal (U-07). Review business-interruption cover, not just property cover.

rows.event: Insurance availability and cost deteriorate, pushing premiums and deductibles onto the tenant or the Owner
rows.mitigation: Confirm who bears insurance cost under the lease and obtain the current premium before any renewal negotiation. Premium is unknown (U-11).

rows.event: Flood or drainage event causes business interruption
rows.mitigation: Check the FEMA flood zone at closing and renewal (U-08).

rows.event: New local transfer tax, rent or business tax, or a split-roll property tax that ends Proposition 13 protection
rows.mitigation: Measure ULA shows how fast the City can change transaction economics. Re-run the model whenever a ballot measure qualifies.

rows.event: Labor-law change raises the tenant's wage floor faster than menu prices can follow
rows.mitigation: The state minimum wage is indexed to CPI-W with a 3.5% annual ceiling; a CPI-linked rent escalator partly offsets this, a flat 2% bump does not.

rows.event: Forced timing: the Owner needs liquidity in a bad market
rows.mitigation: A sellable asset with five or more years of term is itself the liquidity plan. An asset with two years of term is not.

rows.event: The Owner negotiates the renewal first and loses the ability to run a competitive sale process
rows.mitigation: Run both tracks in parallel: an unsigned term sheet is not a commitment, and a marketed asset can still be pulled.

rows.event: The two-track process leaks to the tenant and weakens the Owner's position
rows.mitigation: Use a broker under NDA and a separate counsel for the sale track.

rows.event: Pandemic-scale mandated closure of dine-in and reduced hours
rows.mitigation: Drive-through formats proved more resilient in 2020-2021; confirm the site has one and that the lease does not grant rent abatement on closure.

rows.event: Civil disturbance or prolonged street closure in the trade area
rows.mitigation: Confirm business-interruption and civil-commotion cover.

rows.event: Decision made on stale or secondary data
rows.mitigation: Every figure on this site carries an official source link and an access date. Fourteen items are deliberately blank rather than filled from a secondary source.
